points.bank: Hearth does not connect to your bank or move money. It only keeps what you record.
points.server: Your data lives on your installation's server, not in a third-party cloud.
points.visibility: Only you see your personal space. In a shared space, its members see it; a Viewer can look but not change anything.
points.deletes: Nothing is ever really deleted. A deleted transaction can be recovered, and every change to money is recorded.
points.backups: Every night a copy of everything is saved, and the copies from the last 14 days are kept. Those copies are on the same server: whoever runs it can keep one elsewhere.
